implementation_may_start_when: All four read-only binding hashes match.
Diff is restricted to the repair_contract allowed states/layers and validation scaffolding.
Authority/rules, inherited thresholds, evidence, and exposure boundaries remain byte-for-byte or semantically unchanged as applicable.
product_exposure_remains_blocked_until: All original product-exposure requirements remain satisfied, including complete actual-GPU/manual evidence as required by the original gate and signed real keyboard, pointer, CVD, localization, screen-reader, and external-human sessions.
Unresolved policies remain hidden or receive legitimate rules-owner decisions.
scoped_visual_repair_may_pass_when: 540/540 offline machine matrix passes and is byte-reproducible.
A separately authorized 28/28 targeted actual-GPU set passes machine validation.
Independent TA reviews 28/28 original-resolution PNGs and 280/280 axes with all 32 prior failures repaired and zero regressions.

authority_and_rules: No stable authority header/source, offered action inventory/order, branch, actor rule, ruleset, policy blocker, foundation action, request identity, ACK identity, error mapping, idempotency, mutation, turn, score, rack, breaker, group, entitlement, or validation geometry change.
evidence: Do not overwrite v2 PPM/PNG/JSONL/receipt/manual evidence. v3 outputs use new roots and new manifests. No mockup, CPU raster, flat proof, or design image may substitute for actual GPU evidence.
exposure: No product_exposed, profile_complete, Beta, manual pass, real-human pass, true-input pass, screen-reader pass, or unresolved-policy promotion.
scope_expansion: No new action, recovery control, tooltip authority, gameplay feature, animation dependency, or unrelated HUD/shell/table visual redesign.
thresholds: No contrast, typography, critical-shape, focus-stroke, hit-target, safe-area, table-occlusion, ui-scale range, viewport/density coverage, performance, draw-call, or evidence threshold relaxation.

machine_validation_gate.failure_policy: Any missing case, non-reproducible byte, threshold relaxation, authority drift, token alias, text/layout failure, or visual repair assertion failure is blocking FAIL.
per_case_hard_checks: All original design-gate 540-case hard checks remain enabled and unchanged.
Exact offered actions and order; zero unoffered/foundation actions.
Zero truncated/ellipsized/colliding text, undersized glyph/shape/stroke, unsafe-edge violation, or hit-target overlap.
Open/pending/stale states contain no selected or armed action.
group_choice_armed_confirm contains exact localized action result and actor in both armed and confirm rows.
focus_chevron, selected_check_diamond, and confirm_double_frame_plus_enter_arrow are three independently addressable non-color shapes with no token aliasing.
Every valid placement emits ghost cue-ball plus crosshair in table/world overlay.
Every invalid placement emits ghost cue-ball plus error-cross-octagon plus dashed collision ring and disables confirm.
Every behind-head-string placement emits diagonal hatch, boundary line, bilingual in-world region/scope text, and exact world X/Z coordinates.
Standard/CVD semantic and shape inventory equality.
Local preview and presentation-only repair do not change authority hash/revision/events/actions.
Unknown/stale/error/pending paths remain blocking and action-free as contracted.
machine_validation_gate.required_reproducibility: Two clean offline runs produce byte-identical ordered 540-case JSON and aggregate SHA.

armed_confirm.action_label_source: Use the exact localized label for the armed stable authority action_id; never synthesize, alias, reorder, or substitute an action.
armed_confirm.actor_source: Use the exact actor display derived from actor_player_id in the current offer; no local-player fallback and no stale actor carry-over.
copy_requirements: Both armed and confirm rows name exact_action_result and actor_display.
No generic Confirm armed action / 确认已选处理 copy remains.
Text wraps to at most two action lines, never ellipsizes, and never shrinks below inherited minimum type size.
A changed action or actor clears the arm and rebuilds the row from the latest stable offer.

non_color_shape_tokens.armed: selected_check_diamond attached to the armed action row; remains distinct from focus and confirm
non_color_shape_tokens.color_policy: Shape plus text plus luminance/contrast carry state; hue is supplementary in standard and color_vision_safe palettes.
non_color_shape_tokens.confirm: confirm_double_frame_plus_enter_arrow attached only to the confirm row; remains distinct from focus, armed, disabled, error, and pending
non_color_shape_tokens.focused: focus_chevron; minimum inherited critical-shape size and focus stroke; moves without selecting or submitting

armed_confirm.submission_semantics_unchanged: First action activation arms only. A separate activation of the explicit confirm row submits once. Focus, hover, open, timeout, Escape, resume, right-click, double-click, and focus loss never submit.

behind_head_string.boundary: Continuous head-string boundary line distinct from hatch and table markings.
copy_requirements: Bilingual in-world text names legal region and behind-head-string scope.
The same in-world text carries exact preview coordinates.
No panel-only text may substitute for the required table/world annotation.
Text stays inside safe table/world overlay placement and does not cover candidate, pockets, or head-string boundary.
behind_head_string.hatch: Diagonal hatch fills only the legal side and remains readable in standard/CVD without relying on hue.

in_world_copy.en: Legal region — behind head string • Preview X {x_cm} cm, Z {z_cm} cm
in_world_copy.zh_cn: 合法区域—开球线后 • 预览 X {x_cm} 厘米，Z {z_cm} 厘米

placement_world_overlay.coordinate_source: The exact local preview world X/Z already used by authority validation; formatting may change but values, geometry, and validation semantics may not.

invalid_candidate.confirm_state: Exact placement confirm stays disabled until fresh validation for the exact candidate is legal.
invalid_candidate.dashed_collision_ring: Dashed ring centered on the candidate and scaled to cue-ball collision clearance; dash gaps remain visible at every supported density/ui scale.
invalid_candidate.error_cross_octagon: Non-color error cross inside an octagonal outline centered on the invalid candidate.

preserved_semantics: Preview remains local and never mutates authority revision/hash/events/actions.
Escape/right-click clears local preview only and preserves entitlement/blocking overlay.
Full-table versus behind-head-string validation geometry is unchanged.
Table occlusion and all inherited typography/contrast/safe-area limits remain unchanged.

valid_candidate.crosshair: Orthogonal crosshair centered on the candidate; inherited minimum physical stroke/critical-shape thresholds apply.
valid_candidate.ghost_ball: Circular cue-ball silhouette at the candidate center, visibly translucent/ghosted and spatially distinct from the authoritative cue ball.
valid_candidate.required_text: Preview plus world X/Z coordinates remains readable without occluding the shot-critical candidate.

required_external_sessions.session: keyboard-only traversal, arm/confirm/cancel in en and zh_cn
focus loss, Escape, right-click, double-click, timeout, stale/actor drift, ACK mismatch
independent real-human standard/CVD and localization comparison
screen-reader order and focus-versus-armed distinction in both locales

scope: Repair only the 20 visual cases and 32 manual axes that failed the bound v2 independent manual review. Preserve all authority, action inventory, request/ACK, fail-closed, layout threshold, performance, and exposure semantics.

capture_requirements: Separate explicit root authorization is required after implementation, source freeze, 540/540 machine pass, and no-GPU preflight.
Actual production Core 4.1 path after ACES tone map with shipping fonts/icons; no GPU evidence may be generated by this gate.
Use a new v3 evidence root and never overwrite any v2 evidence.
Record PNG path/SHA/physical dimensions, source/runner/binary bindings, render-pass order, draw calls, and hit rectangles.
All 28 captures pass machine validation. Any omitted-corner anomaly or manual doubt expands the targeted set before TA review.

coverage_rationale.group_open_controls: Four profiles prove no default selection and no focus/armed/confirm token leakage at modal open.
coverage_rationale.repair_cases: All v2 manual FAIL cases: armed/confirm across four profiles plus every full-table/behind-head valid/invalid profile.
coverage_rationale.shared_action_controls: Eight-on-break and break-illegal open states protect shared action-row inventory and unselected styling.
coverage_rationale.status_controls: Submitting and authority-error states protect product status/error shape separation from new confirm/invalid tokens.

targeted_actual_gpu_gate.proof_boundary: 28/28 targeted actual-GPU machine pass closes only the scoped v3 visual-repair raster gate; it does not equal product exposure, Beta, real-input, screen-reader, localization, CVD-human, or external-QA pass.

method: Open all 28 bound PNGs individually at original physical resolution.
Review every image on all ten original axes; no inherited machine/manual PASS.
Compare each repaired case against its exact v2 stable PNG and record before/after paths and SHA.
All 32 previously failed axis occurrences must become PASS; no other axis may regress.
Any blocking defect makes the v3 TA result FAIL.
technical_art_re_review_gate.reviewer: Independent technical-art reviewer who did not implement the v3 repair.
